summary: FromHexError::InvalidHexCharacter formatted control characters literally, so a newline produced a multiline error message. The fix uses debug formatting to escape the character. The existing test_display test, updated by this fix, expects an escaped newline at position 5.
expected_failure: Equality assertion failure: the actual message contains a raw newline between quotes at position 5, while the expected message contains the literal escape sequence '\n'.

reversal.fixed_text: write!(f, "Invalid character {:?} at position {}", c, index)
reversal.parent_text: write!(f, "Invalid character '{}' at position {}", c, index)
